TextBlock.Text: DARWIN APPROACHES, July 1988. Exercise PITCH BLACK's maritime phase, with an American carrier group south of the Arafura and a mixed aggressor force flying Soviet and Chinese profiles. A Bear G is running the maritime strike serial with a Badger tanker behind it, a Dragon Lady is high over the exercise box, and the Nighthawk detachment is flying its first Southern Hemisphere sortie with the aggressor squadron's J-8s and MiG-23 as its problem. It was an exercise until 0412, when the Bear released a live round at the range ship and the aggressors started answering with real missiles. The umpires are still on the net: the Badger tanker is out of play and a shot at it is scored against you.
Exercise Director, PITCH BLACK 88, maritime phase
Kill the Bear before its release line, leave the Badger tanker alone - the umpires still score that - and bring the U-2 home.
Serial: Kill the Bear before its release line Recovery: Bring the U-2, Dragon 41, home Umpire: The tanker is out of play - a shot at it is scored against you
USS Kitty Hawk, F-14A and F-117 detachments, a B-52G, a U-2, an Italian Tornado on exchange. Aggressors: two J-8, a MiG-23, a Bear G, a Tu-16N tanker.
60 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.

F-117 Nighthawk, Italian Navy Mod, B-52G with AGM-86 (realistic nuke), U-2 "Dragon Lady", Flight Deck Ops, A-10A Thunderbolt II, Tu-95K-22 Bear G MOD, <<Tu-16N>>, Shenyang J-8, Custom Loadout Editor, the base game.
